Use-case/requirements summary (short):
- Workload: interactive in-app chat assistant embedded inside product UI. Emphasis on streaming partial responses and minimal TTFB.
- Latency SLOs: first byte <300ms for <32 token responses; overall completion <1.5s typical.
- Throughput: pilot 30-60 concurrent sessions; peak 50 req/s.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants cost/latency tradeoffs (quantized model suggestions, caching) and a clear per-session estimate.
- Model preferences: open models okay; want ability to pin stable model version and fallback to cheaper variant.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted API but want transparent fallback rules (e.g., lower-cost model when quota triggers).
- Security/compliance: SOC2 preferred, SSO/SAML for admin access, audit logs for key admin actions.

- Provide quick benchmark doc (us-west latency numbers + recommended SDK keepalive/warmup). Link to sample bench in Drive. (Action: Ravi)
